items.description: Median solvers per post by slot (8 weeks), daily shop and app openers

dailyPostSlot.label: Daily puzzle post time
dailyPostSlot.helpText: When the daily puzzle posts. A change applies from the next scheduled post, and a day never gets a second scheduled post.

firstScreen.label: Show the rules line and start new players on Easy
firstScreen.helpText: Shows "Binary Grid #N · r/{subreddit}", one rules line and the ○/| legend above the grid, and opens Easy for logged-out players and players who have never solved. Off: the plain grid, on Medium for everyone. Change it only between daily puzzles.

streakRule.label: Streak rule
streakRule.helpText: How streaks count. By puzzle: a solve counts for its #N within the streak window after it posts. By calendar day: the rule before puzzle streaks. Both are kept up to date, so switching applies on the next screen load and loses nothing.

streakWindowHours.label: Streak window (hours)
streakWindowHours.helpText: How long after a puzzle posts a solve still counts for its streak, under the puzzle rule. 1 to 168; any other value uses 36. Changes apply to every streak on the next read.
